shadows.name: ambient-overlay
shadows.purpose: Mobile navigation, toast, and login panel only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main confirmed command in a workbench.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent); color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); font: 650 14px system-ui; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-raised); color: var(--text); font: 650 14px system-ui; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact operational input with explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px system-ui; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 22px; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--success) 45%, var(--line)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--success-soft); color: var(--success); font: 700 11px system-ui; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A selected route in the shared product shell.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-strong); font: 650 14px system-ui; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--bg-soft); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: BolterTrader is a focused operational surface for one experienced trader. It is dense enough for repeated comparison, quiet enough for long sessions, and explicit whenever state is provisional, degraded, denied, or uncertain.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained graphite surfaces with one muted blue action accent.
Separate green, amber, and red semantic states that always include text.
Tight tables, fixed controls, tabular numbers, and predictable navigation.
Flat-by-default surfaces with borders and tonal layering instead of card mosaics.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Action blue occupies no more than ten percent of a screen. It indicates selection or agency, never decoration.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Streaming numeric values use monospace tabular figures and never resize their container.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Tables, workbenches, settings bands, and page sections never float with decorative shadows.

dos: Do show authoritative server state and keep provisional, stale, degraded, uncertain, blocked, and manual-intervention states distinct.
Do keep account, environment, instrument, quantity, notional, product, and warnings visible at decision points.
donts: Don't use neon-on-black effects, glowing gradients, or speculative visual noise.
Don't use card mosaics, nested cards, glassmorphism, or decorative dashboards.
